about_the_game:
Try Guitarist’s Reference Demo – Your First Step to Mastering the Fretboard!

Explore a powerful set of guitar tools and learning resources with the free demo version of Guitarist’s Reference. Whether you're a beginner or brushing up on your skills, this demo offers a glimpse of what the full app has to offer.

Included in the Demo:

  • Chords and Triads: Access all chord types within Major and Minor chords. View clear diagrams and understand finger positions with ease.

  • Chord Quiz (Easy Level Only): Test your chord recognition skills with the Easy level quiz – great for newcomers to guitar theory.

  • Reverse Chord & Scale Finder: Search results appear normally, but previewing them on the fretboard is disabled in the demo.

  • Scales Explorer: Discover all scale types under Major Scale Modes and Harmonic Minor Modes.

  • Arpeggios Reference: All arpeggio types are available within Major and Minor categories.

  • Tunings: Practice using Standard Tuning and a selection of Open Tunings.

  • Virtual Guitar (Default Sound Only): Experiment with fretboard interaction using the default guitar sound. Alternate sound sets are locked in the demo.

Want More?

Upgrade to the full version to unlock:

  • 3,000+ chords across all types

  • 42 scale types including Pentatonic, Dorian, Lydian, Blues, and more

  • All arpeggios and advanced chord progressions

  • Full Chord & Scale Finder with interactive fretboard

  • 36 alternate tunings with information

  • Premium themes, sounds, and advanced tools

Experience the essence of a full-featured guitarist’s toolkit with this limited preview. When you're ready, unlock the full experience and take your fretboard mastery to the next level.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics or better
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Required
  • Additional Notes: Universal binary: supports Intel and Apple Silicon

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 1.5 GHz dual-core processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics or Any GPU
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 64-bit systems
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz dual-core or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or discrete graphics card
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Supports high-DPI displays.
